meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared ready-model selection, strict assistant tool-call validation and direct Luna settings with the runtime guide. Campaign enquiry continues through the existing PHP Contact and Inbox path.

auth.review_note: Checked campaign CSRF, session-bound submission token and owner Inbox authorization against existing login/account policy, including guest and customer access checks.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the campaign additions against the order and catalogue contracts; campaign validation and owner CRM records do not enter commerce order, checkout or revenue processing.

content.review_note: Reviewed the merged database service and controller boundaries against authored pages and campaign guidance. The storefront action uses a separate audit query and does not change campaign receipts or revisions.

foundation.review_note: Compared the one unbuffered MySQL query, PDO cleanup and fixed authenticated response with the storage guide and exact cutoff fixture.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the inherited Integrations provider instructions and Google reporting controls. Campaign presentation remains within the shared document body.

http-errors.review_note: Checked the native enquiry route failure handling against the HTTP response guard; unavailable writes are presented on-page and the campaign path logs a generic outcome.

interface.review_note: Reviewed the Dashboard counters and unavailable state against the admin guide. Design still describes the optional header, reading layout and enquiry controls.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the inbox projection and priority of recorded campaign enquiries against the mail guide. Storefront counters only query the audit collection.

mcp-clients.review_note: Checked the merged Integrations guide against the local MCP client controller and form. The owner issues and revokes a paid-sales grant, and the trusted STDIO client receives it through its process environment.

media.review_note: Reviewed the Owner UI skill and shared upload lock documentation against the media source. Campaign layout renders the same owned image before the enquiry form.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the storefront counters and unavailable status with owner Reports. The Pages and Inbox guides still match header and enquiry controls.

public-mcp.review_note: Cross-checked Dashboard and authored page route associations with Public MCP and A2UI. The new Dashboard query uses the authenticated database bridge.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the fixed authenticated storefront read alongside the existing cart and checkout contracts. It returns two counts and issues no writes.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the merged CI and generated maps. MySQL and MariaDB jobs exercise storefront reads alongside the campaign form and authored page checks.
